accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The identification frontier is conditional on finite state spaces, strictly positive primitive kernels, and an unknown full-column-rank proxy channel; boundary outcome slices and incomplete proxy channels are outside the claim.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Exact target-span identification and the local full-law converse hold only over the stated positive, injective finite latent-shift SCM fiber.

source_verification_receipts.version: author manuscript corresponding to Statistics & Probability Letters 198 (2023), Article 109836; journal full text was inaccessible at the publisher
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Proposition 2.3 identifies a linear bridge functional iff its loading lies in the orthocomplement of the conditional-expectation operator null space; Lemma 2.4 distinguishes this from adjoint-range root-n estimability.
The paper derives boundedness conditions and analytic scalar projection confidence sets from Anderson--Rubin-type regions in linear structural models.
The subvector AR/CQLR result assumes a compact nuisance parameter space and additional regularity; it is not a theorem for an unrestricted, nonunique balancing fiber.
